en.body:
Get ready to add a chilling new title to your home entertainment collection. **Curry Barker's** directorial debut, **Obsession**, has officially made its digital debut on June 30, 2026, with physical releases on 4K UHD combo pack, Blu-ray™, and DVD following on July 14, 2026, from Universal Pictures Home Entertainment. This R-rated psychological thriller, which clocks in at 109 minutes, has been one of 2026's most talked-about films, captivating audiences with its cautionary tale of desire and consequence.

Born from a modest budget of under $1 million and a buzz-generating premiere at TIFF, **Obsession** quickly transformed into a global phenomenon. Acquired by Focus for approximately $15 million, the film has since amassed nearly half a billion dollars worldwide, cementing its status as a true breakout hit. The story centers on a hopeless romantic who, in a desperate attempt to win over his crush, breaks a mysterious "One Wish Willow." While his wish is granted, he soon discovers that some desires come with a dark, sinister price, leading to dire and unforeseen consequences.

## The Phenomenon of 'Obsession'

The explosive success of **Obsession** is more than just the announcement of a new directorial talent in **Curry Barker**; it signals a potential paradigm shift within the horror industry. Alongside films like "Backrooms" and last year's "Iron Lung," **Obsession** appears to be part of a new wave of horror filmmaking that resonates deeply with audiences. Its blend of identity fixation and psychological tension has clearly struck a chord, proving that compelling storytelling and a unique vision can achieve massive commercial success.

## What Fans Can Expect

For those who missed its record-breaking theatrical run or are eager to revisit its unsettling atmosphere, the home entertainment release offers a chance to experience **Obsession** in the comfort of your own home. The digital and physical editions bring Barker's tense narrative to audiences who appreciate smart, character-driven horror that explores the darker aspects of human nature. The film's journey from indie darling to blockbuster sensation is a testament to its potent appeal, making it a must-watch for fans of the genre.

## What's Next

With its home entertainment release now underway, the conversation around **Obsession** is sure to continue. Fans will be eagerly awaiting any news regarding potential sequels or future projects from director **Curry Barker**, whose distinctive voice has clearly made a significant impact on contemporary cinema.
